title: kv-cache: adaptive memory rebalancer + spillover eviction priority improvements
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: long-lived conversational workloads with high prefix reuse were suffering from KV cache fragmentation and thrashing when spillover/paging kicked in, causing increased tail latency and token cost. This PR introduces an adaptive memory rebalancer that proactively reassigns ephemeral KV pages between models/contexts, plus an improved spillover eviction priority that reduces unnecessary defragmentation and evictions for hot prefixes. Summary of changes: - Adaptive memory rebalancer: background coordinator that monitors per-shard fragmentation, live KV weight, and access heat to migrate pages between pools. The coordinator surface is disabled by default and gated by --kv.rebalancer.enabled and --kv.rebalancer.target-utilization. - Spillover eviction priority: new multi-factor scoring (age, access-frequency, fragmentation-contribution, model-priority) that prefers compacting low-fragmentation cold slices before evicting hot prefix pages. This reduces prefix reconstruction and cache misses. - Defrag/compaction improvements: thresholding to avoid repeated small compactions, added compaction backoff and coalescing to batch work during low-load windows. - Corrected memory-accounting bug where transient page reservations were double-counted during speculative allocations (fixes observed leak in perf canary). - Metrics + tracing: added kv.rebalancer.* metrics, kv.eviction.score histogram, kv.compaction.window histograms, and distributed trace spans for rebalancer decisions. - Tests and perf: unit tests for scoring logic, integration test harness updates to simulate multi-model contention, and perf bench scenarios showing 8-12% tail-latency improvement and 6-9% token-cost reduction on high-fragmentation traces. Checklist: - [x] Implementation - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests - [x] Perf benchmarks - [x] Docs + config flags - [x] Metrics/tracing - [x] Review feedback addressed Rollout plan: feature is behind feature flag by default; will be enabled on a canary pool for 2 weeks before broader rollout. See release_notes for backward-compat notes.

release_notes: Adaptive KV rebalancer (opt-in) and improved spillover eviction priority. Defaults: rebalancer disabled. When enabled, expect lower tail latency and fewer prefix evictions in high-fragmentation workloads. Config flags: --kv.rebalancer.enabled=false (default), --kv.rebalancer.target-utilization=0.78, --kv.eviction.score-weight-fragmentation=1.2. No breaking changes; minor config names added. Backport candidate for 2026.02.x.
